before.description:
## Current architecture and delivery

Omux owns each adapted application's authentication contract and implementation. Use sufficient native extension mechanisms or an Omux-maintained adapter delivered through plugin/configuration, upstream contribution or explicitly maintained application modification. There is no vendor-provided Omux/Codex hook prerequisite. Experimental candidate proof does not establish unmodified Codex support.

Delivery order: install/activate → Chromium source connection → verified identity and usable authority → renewal → ordinary application integration → same-process handoff. Home Manager owns fleet packages/services/exact-ID host registration; Omux owns custody/enrollment. Development and release identities and namespaces remain isolated.

## This carrier

Shared native UI/CLI setup and repair independently report installation, artifact/channel, resident service, vault, source, verified identity, usable grant and adapter capability. Honor declarative ownership; never overwrite managed files. Explicit receipt selection is required; prefix-only hints infer no ownership.

Acceptance: guided reversible setup; truthful missing/incompatible/pending/stale observations; preserve native stores; daemon survives client closure; key-loss recovery enrolls into separate custody. US-INSTALL-01, US-SOURCE-01, US-REPAIR-01, SC-01/03/08. Paths: delivery/, clients/, nix/, src/setup_collector.zig, src/service_observation.zig. TIN-2797/5340/2830 retain UI/vault/installed gates; TIN-5442 retains browser lifecycle.

Current bounded evidence — resumed October 5: ef255a3e passed all twelve declared targets, including actual packaged Linux CLI/Qt, resident daemon survival after closing controls, encrypted custody/restart, immutable terminal replay, channel separation and paired exact-ID native-host registration. ID-CHANNEL and ID-SETUP pass for those exact experimental Linux artifacts; OS-service activation, complete onboarding/enrollment, Home Manager activation, actual browser consent, native continuity, Darwin and achieved SLO remain open. Earlier bc1fa374 disk cancellation remains historical; the operator allocation is restored. Workspace evidence paths (unpublished): docs/tracker-updates/integrated-delivery-installed-setup-2026-10-05.json and integrated-delivery-resume-2026-10-05.json.

## Evidence and retained history

Require exact source/artifact/platform/application/provider tuple and declared locked Nix/Bazel action. Browser execution, service activation, native launch/resume, handoff and measured SLO achievement are separate gates. Builds/tests/refusals prove only stated predicates. Targets create no contractual SLA or staffed support promise. This description changes no issue state, date, assignee or dependency.

Authority: [AGENTS.md](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/AGENTS.md>), [architecture SSOT](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/docs/plans/omux-native-account-lifecycle-reset-2026-10-02.md>), [delivery plan](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/docs/plans/omux-integrated-delivery-sprint-2026-10-05.md>), product/user-stories.md, spec/native-adapter-contract.md and reliability/service-objectives.md.

Complete predecessor description and exact readbacks remain in [durable before snapshots](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/docs/tracker-updates/integrated-delivery-2026-10-05.json>) and [this issue's retained history/comments](<https://linear.app/tinyland/issue/TIN-2063>). Dated historical measurements/releases retain their original candidate/date scope. Current scope supersedes old operational dictates without erasing historical evidence.

Historical 0/11/82-pass score and v0.1.15 retain their recorded candidate/release truth. New source/build/portable staged CLI/refusal predicates close only their named scope, not whole product support. Fleet activation, ordinary native resume, provider/live handoff, Darwin and achieved lifecycle SLO remain unproved. Earlier failed Chromium epochs retain their evidence.
